verdict.rationale: Fastmail's docs confirm built-in Calendar with event and invitation handling directly in the mail/webmail client (fastmail-docs-14/34), and JMAP supports calendar via CalDAV replacement (fastmail-docs-42), consistent with an integrated calendar app alongside email. However, evidence lacks hands-on/community confirmation of the invite-response and event-creation UX specifically. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of calendar RSVP and event-creation workflow, and detail on UI integration depth.
